admission.justification: A future handoff refactor must not force two publications, allocate a second invariant for an attachment, or let an attachment silently rewrite the author statement. The ordering and equality boundary prevents those provenance and identity mistakes.

applicability: An attaching entry in one knowledge-ingest handoff names invariant_id=handoff:<entry id> of an invariant authored in that same handoff.
conditions: Process authoring entries before same-document attachments regardless of their input order.
The referenced authoring entry must exist and the attaching statement must equal its author statement; refuse a missing author or unequal statement before binding the attachment handle.
Bind a successful attachment to the author already allocated invariant ID, not to another newly minted record.
exclusions: Stored-invariant IDs continue through their separate existing-record path.
Authoring._invariant_document constructs fields but is not claimed as the equal-statement refusal; that check belongs to assign_entries.
No claim that a historical discovery span or an old producer pending disposition is a fresh CODE verdict.
statement: A handoff may attach to an invariant it authors in the same document only after the authoring entry and with an equal statement.
